Accounting (BS)

Leventhal School of Accounting

Overview

The Bachelor of Science in Accounting prepares students for careers in public accounting, corporate finance and advisory services, combining a rigorous accounting core with the Marshall business curriculum and significant course work in analytics.

Degree Requirements

Completion of at least 128 units is required, including the business core, the accounting core listed below, and general education. A minimum grade point average of 2.5 in all accounting course work is required.

Required Accounting Core
CourseTitleUnits
ACCT 410Foundations of Accounting4
ACCT 411Introduction to Accounting Systems2
ACCT 470Advanced External Financial Reporting Issues4

* Transfer students must complete ACCT 410 in residence. See the Leventhal residency policy for details.

Additional Requirements

  • WRIT 340 Advanced Writing (4 units)
  • Completion of the international experience requirement
    • Study abroad, international internship, or approved course sequence
